title: Essential Travel Guide: Guwahati to Kaziranga National Park
description: Planning a jungle safari to Kaziranga? Here is everything you need to know about vehicle selection, travel duration, and route tips.
body:
## Journey to the Home of the One-Horned Rhino

Located approximately 193 km from Guwahati, Kaziranga National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage site and a must-visit destination in Assam.

### Best Time to Visit
The park is open from **October to April**. The pleasant winter season makes for smooth highway driving and comfortable wildlife safaris.

### Travel Options with Cars on Rent
Whether you need an SUV like Toyota Innova Crysta for your family or a Tempo Traveller for group travel, we ensure a safe and smooth highway drive right from Guwahati airport or railway station.
